title: The Amazing World of Water Pressure
intro: This quiz checks what you learned about fluids and the laws of liquid pressure.

choices: A substance that is always solid
A substance that has no pressure
A substance that cannot change shape
questions.explanation: A fluid is a substance that can flow. Both liquids and gases are fluids.

questions.prompt: At the same point in a liquid at rest, how does pressure act?
questions.explanation: At the same point in a liquid at rest, pressure is equal in every direction.

questions.prompt: What happens to liquid pressure as depth increases?
questions.explanation: Liquid pressure increases with depth. The deeper you go, the greater the pressure.

questions.prompt: Which formula is used to calculate pressure due to a liquid column?
questions.explanation: Pressure due to a liquid column is P = dgh (density × g × depth).

questions.prompt: What happens to the same liquid in connected open containers of different shapes?
choices: It settles at the same level
It flows only into the widest container
questions.explanation: In connected vessels, the same liquid settles at the same level.
